one_liner_zh: Intuit EPS 12.80 美元超預期、營收年增10.4%，TurboTax 與 QuickBooks 受 AI 加值持續穩健成長。
one_liner_en: Intuit beat EPS at $12.80 with 10.4% revenue growth, as AI-enhanced TurboTax and QuickBooks sustained steady momentum.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 1.84%、營收年增 10.37%，穩健達標。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：營收與獲利雙超預期且維持雙位數成長，顯示 AI 加值與平台交叉銷售有效推升 ARPU。本益比約17倍對其成長與現金流品質而言不算昂貴。短期財報利多支撐股價。中期追蹤線上生態系（Online Ecosystem）營收成長、中小企業客戶留存、AI 變現滲透率與報稅季表現。政策性免費報稅為長期觀察變數。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: revenue and earnings both beat with double-digit growth, showing AI enhancements and cross-sell lifting ARPU. A ~17x P/E is undemanding given growth and cash flow quality. Near term the beat supports the stock. Mid term, track Online Ecosystem revenue growth, SMB retention, AI monetization adoption and tax-season performance. Policy-driven free filing is a long-term watch item.
highlights_zh: EPS 12.80 美元，超預期 1.84%，獲利穩健
TurboTax、QuickBooks 與 Credit Karma 平台協同
AI 助手（Intuit Assist）強化產品定價力與留存
highlights_en: EPS of $12.80 beat by 1.84%, solid profitability
Synergy across TurboTax, QuickBooks and Credit Karma
AI assistant (Intuit Assist) strengthens pricing power and retention
risks_zh: 報稅季節性使各季營收波動大
中小企業景氣放緩影響 QuickBooks 用戶活躍度
免費報稅政策（IRS Direct File）潛在競爭威脅
risks_en: Tax-season seasonality drives large quarterly revenue swings
SMB slowdown could affect QuickBooks user activity
Potential competition from free filing (IRS Direct File)
